# incusos_system_power (Resource)

Manages IncusOS system power management configuration (`/1.0/system/power`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cpu_energy_performance_preference` (String) CPU energy performance preference (e.g., `balance_performance`, `power`).
- `cpu_scaling_governor` (String) CPU frequency scaling governor (e.g., `performance`, `powersave`).
- `screen_blank_timeout` (Number) Console screen blanking timeout in minutes without keyboard input (0 to 60; 0 disables blanking).

### Read-Only

- `cpu_available_governors` (List of String) Available CPU scaling governors reported by the host.
- `cpu_available_preferences` (List of String) Available CPU energy performance preferences reported by the host.
- `cpu_scaling_driver` (String) Active CPU scaling driver reported by the host.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
